result.rationale: The diff shows zoho-bigin calls refreshOAuthTokens(..., "zoho-bigin", credentialId) while every other call site (googlecalendar, hubspot, lark, office365, webex, zoom, zohocrm) passes credential.userId, and refreshOAuthTokens sends the third argument as calcomUserId to the sync endpoint. Passing a credential id where a user id is expected would sync tokens to the wrong account. Whether `credentialId` is even in scope in that class method can't be fully verified from the diff (the class stores this.credentialId), but the id-type mismatch is visible directly.

judged_text: zoho-bigin passes credentialId as refreshOAuthTokens' third argument, which every other call site populates with credential.userId and which the helper sends as calcomUserId in the sync request. The credential-sync endpoint receives a credential id where it expects a Cal.com user id, resolves the wrong user (or none), and refreshed tokens are synced against the wrong account; if no local credentialId is in scope this reference additionally breaks the build since the class stores the value as this.credentialId.
